first.rationale: Current state shows twin declines in activation (6% QoQ) and onboarding completion (4% QoQ), both negatively trending metrics. Memory_31 and memory_86 establish that simplification and shortening onboarding have produced durable lifts in activation and completion. Memory_91 confirms activation messaging also works, but onboarding completion is the mechanistic bottleneck—if users don't complete onboarding, downstream activation messaging has fewer users to influence. Verifying memory_31 (signup simplification) and memory_91 (activation messaging) will clarify whether the decline is primarily a friction problem at entry (suggesting simplify_onboarding) or a product-experience problem post-entry (suggesting activation_messaging). Simplify_onboarding is the highest-leverage single lever given both metrics are down. Promotional_pricing addresses competitor pressure but is reactive and does not address the underlying activation/completion decline; it also risks margin. Enterprise_sales_assist is high-value but doesn't address the SMB segment most affected by the competitor's entry pricing. A standard_experiment on simplified onboarding preserves the option to layer pricing response later while addressing the mechanical drag on funnel health.

final.rationale: The archive clarifies the mechanism. Memory_31 (signup simplification) drove +9% activation on SMB but shows -1% retention risk, suggesting it may lower segment quality. Memory_91 (activation messaging) achieved +6% activation with +1% retention gain and +11% week-one engagement—the only tested lever that improves both activation and retention simultaneously. Current situation shows activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ across the company. Activation_messaging is segment-agnostic and de-risks the quality concern present in signup simplification. It directly addresses the activation decline, preserves retention, and works on both self-serve (memory_91 demonstrated this) and can support enterprise paths. Given the 6% activation decline is larger than the 4% onboarding decline, and given that activation_messaging improves engagement without the retention trade-off of signup simplification, this is the highest-confidence lever for sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Standard_experiment scope allows rapid validation before broader rollout.
